text:
China’s economic growth is expected to slow further next year as export strength fades and weak domestic demand persists, even as the global economy remains resilient, according to a new outlook from the Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE).
The Washington-based think tank projects China’s GDP will grow 4.6 per cent this year and 4.3 per cen
text_zh: 彼得森国际经济研究所（PIIE）最新展望指出，随着出口强劲势头消退、国内需求持续疲软，预计中国明年经济增长将进一步放缓，尽管全球经济仍保持韧性。这家总部位于华盛顿的智库预计，今年中国GDP将增长4.6%，明年增长4.3%。
